ConnectionStrings.//: Set via environment variables in every deployed environment: ConnectionStrings__App, ConnectionStrings__Platform, ConnectionStrings__Migrations. Never commit real credentials.

App.//: Public base URL of the web app, used to build links in emails. Required in production.

Smtp.//: Set Email__Smtp__Host/Username/Password via environment variables. Never commit SMTP credentials.

Media.//: S3 or S3-compatible storage for product images. Leave Bucket empty to disable uploads. Secrets (Media__SecretKey) via environment only.
